run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the number occurring an odd number of times in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets and compare results with f_filled
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses a hash dictionary to count element frequencies and find odd occurrences
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that returns the element with an odd frequency count from an array
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use XOR-based approach instead of a hash dictionary for better performance
